title: Hệ thống Nhận diện Thương hiệu

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the terminology related to brand identity systems and grasp the functions, tasks, practical applications, and theories of brand identity in business.
Possess knowledge to build a unified vision and strategic goals for a business, and manage and exploit brand identity systems in brand communication.
Analyze the impact of marketing environment factors on brand identity management, and apply brand identity knowledge to new and familiar situations to develop creative brand identity solutions.
Understand the process, manage brand identity systems, and oversee brand-building and maintenance activities through core and applied brand identity systems.
Develop creative ideas for brand identity systems, materialize core elements that reflect brand identity, and use brand identity systems in static and dynamic communication.
Collaborate effectively in group projects, presenting and defending ideas and solutions in a structured and persuasive manner.
Effectively present and defend ideas and solutions in a structured and persuasive manner.
Analyze and solve problems related to brand identity systems, and develop creative solutions to adapt to changes in the business environment.
Communicate effectively in both static and dynamic brand communication contexts.
Manage and deliver group projects, including data collection, analysis, and solution proposal.
